method: Fresh Dental OS implementation of the pinned Treatment Progress workflow and API contract. The SaaS presentation and business transport are not copied; rendering, filtering, and refresh are adapted to the Dental OS shared UI and ClinicClient.

imports.disposition: Workflow and visible fields adapted: clinic-wide incomplete-treatment worklist, patient and doctor filters, progress counts, balance, next return, and refresh. Patient-detail navigation is omitted because the OS has no approved cross-app navigation contract.
GET /v1/treatment-progress retained through the Dental OS ClinicClient; no direct HTTP or credential handling.
TreatmentProgressRow fields adapted with runtime response validation.

contractSources.disposition: Projection returns active patients with open cases and incomplete non-cancelled stages, including worker-calculated completed/total counts, doctor names, current balance, and next pending return date.

excluded: Direct HTTP transport and API base URL
Patient record creation or cross-app navigation
Platform runtime, preload, broker implementation, and host code
